description: This is a Python source file that sets up a Streamlit-based web application integrating a language model and SQL database for a chatbot interface. It includes environment configuration, database connection, LLM and agent setup, a prompt template for user queries, and a function to process queries with token counting and exception handling.

classes.name: traceable
classes.description: A decorator for tracing function calls, imported from langsmith.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Processes a user query by combining it with a prompt template, runs the chain, and handles token counting and exceptions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Runs the Streamlit app, managing chat interface, user input, and invoking the query processing function.
